from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u090/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bde31ab1.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] != 0 and (nr, nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            nines = sum(grid[rr][cc] == 9 for rr, cc in cells)
            objects.append((cells, nines))
    if not objects:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Select the object with the fewest red cells; on ties, choose the highest red-cell density.
    min_nines = min(n for _, n in objects)
    tied = [(cells, n) for cells, n in objects if n == min_nines]
    cells, _ = max(tied, key=lambda item: item[1] / len(item[0]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = 0
    return out
'''
